Severe Weather Alert Issued for Southwest Buenos Aires The National Meteorological Service has issued a new ‍weather alert for potential storms and winds reaching up to 90 kilometers per hour in Bahía Blanca⁢ and much of the Southwest⁢ Buenos Aires region. This warning is in effect for Friday afternoon and encompasses several‍ districts, including villarino, Puan, Adolfo Alsina, Guaminí, Coronel Suárez , Saavedra, Colonel pringles, ​Tornquist, Colonel Rosales, Bahía Blanca,​ Monte Hermoso, Patagones, and the southern ⁢part of Coronel Dorrego. ⁤Additionally,it covers ‍the eastern part of Río Negro and much of La Pampa.The alert, classified as‍ a yellow level,⁣ indicates that “the ‌area will be affected by rains and storms, some locally strong.” According to the service, these storms will be accompanied by heavy rainfall in short ⁣periods, electrical activity, occasional hail, ⁢and gusts that could range between 60 and 90 kilometers per hour.Within this framework, the Meteorological service anticipates accumulated precipitation values ⁢between 15 ‍and 40 millimeters, which could be ‍exceeded in a ​timely manner. In response,the service ‍has issued ⁢a series of recommendations. These include not removing garbage to⁣ prevent water from draining, avoiding outdoor activities, and steering clear of trees and electricity posts that may fall.
To minimize the risk of being struck by lightning, the‍ service ‌advises against remaining on beaches, rivers, lagoons, or pools. ‌It ⁤also⁣ recommends being attentive to possible hailfall and ​staying informed through official channels. Additionally, it is ⁢advisable to have⁤ an ​emergency ​backpack containing a flashlight, radio, documents, and a telephone.
The Satelmet service ‌has forecast a day‍ with a minimum temperature of ⁤19 degrees celsius⁢ and a ⁢maximum of 32 degrees Celsius in Bahía Blanca.
